logs.summary: Torrential rain starting late on August 13, 2023, caused record-breaking flooding in eastern Japan, particularly in Chiba Prefecture. Authorities issued the highest-level rain warnings as the region experienced unprecedented rainfall, equivalent to three months' worth in 12 hours.

logs.summary: A moderate earthquake struck the Kermadec Islands region of New Zealand on August 30, 2026, at around 09:02 GMT. The magnitude was reported as 5.8 by some sources, with other agencies recording 5.9 or 5.7. There were no immediate reports of damage or tsunami threat.

news.body: HONG KONG, Aug. 30 (Xinhua) -- An earthquake with a magnitude of 5.9 jolted Kermadec Islands, New Zealand, at 0902 GMT on Sunday, the GFZ German Research Centre for Geosciences said.
